name: RG Singing AI Recording Tool
scope: FFT-based normalized autocorrelation to reduce F0/HNR diagnostic compute cost
Parabolic lag interpolation and F0 confidence proxy
Strict input validation, finite-value checks, and frame-count consistency checks
Atomic NPZ output and refusal to overwrite unless --overwrite is specified
Expanded automated tests and corrected GUI log line breaks
limitations: All P2 acoustic descriptors remain diagnostic estimates, not calibrated ground truth
F0 estimator is not a production-grade singing pitch tracker
Formant estimation is coarse spectral peak picking
No singing synthesis training or inference model
Windows GUI and audio-device integration require testing on the target PC
